name: Thai Coconut Curry Pork Shoulder
why: Solidly mid-band low-carb braised pork shoulder: published 548 cal / 29.9g protein / 6.1g carbs (4.6g net) per serving on the source's own numbers - sits in the sweet spot the run asked for (450-600 cal, well under the 35g carb ceiling) with strong protein-to-calorie ratio, so it will survive our label-accurate recomputation with room on both sides of the band. Structurally low-carb (fatty pork shoulder braised in coconut milk + aromatics, no rice/noodle/potato base). Pork shoulder cubed and braised is dead-center in lane. Distinct from catalog: existing Thai pork is basil pad kra pao, drunken noodles and peanut tenderloin - no coconut-curry pork; and all coconut Thai curries in the catalog are chicken. Batch-scales cleanly to 14 in a big braise pot or slow cooker with weigh-and-divide. Flagged unmapped signature ingredients (creamed coconut, whole Thai chilies, cardamom pods, fresh turmeric root) are a feature for the pricer-lane proving run - coconut-milk-canned/red-curry-paste/lemongrass-paste are the obvious board-resident stand-ins if the selector prefers.
